verdict.rationale: Gitea is a Git hosting platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question here. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp. That is the vendor's own capability, but it rests on a single thin probe line, with no detail on tools exposed, setup, auth, or agent compatibility. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP tools/capabilities, setup and authentication guidance, supported agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp
